description: Update a theme (a.k.a. cluster — the same record as its delivery program): name, status/horizon, colour, and the CHARTER lines (standsToday, fundingSource, stopCondition, waitsFor, dependsOnThemeIds). A theme carries no strategy link: the objectives it serves are derived from the key results its program's initiatives name (anyforge_set_initiative_key_results). fundingSource + stopCondition are what delivery condition 4 checks; dependsOnThemeIds is what condition 5 walks. Changing `status` MOVES the cluster between horizons and is the only place that can be done. At least one field must be provided. Requires `write` scope.

archived.description: Set true to soft-archive this theme; false to restore it.

color.description: Display color for the theme (e.g. hex code).

dependsOnThemeIds.description: Charter: clusters this one cannot finish without, as theme ids. Walked by delivery condition 5.

description.description: Updated description of what this theme covers.

fundingSource.description: Charter: where the money comes from. Checked by delivery condition 4.

id.description: ID of the theme to update.

objective.description: Free-text outcome for the roadmap card.

ownerId.description: UID of the user responsible for this theme.

standsToday.description: Charter: what is measurably true today, each figure with the document it came from.

status.description: Theme status. Allowed: NOW | NEXT | LATER | DONE | ARCHIVED. LATER is shown as "Beyond". This is the only place a cluster changes horizon.

stopCondition.description: Charter: what would make us stop. Checked by delivery condition 4.

tags.description: List of string tags to associate with the theme.

waitsFor.description: Charter: the condition that must hold before this cluster can start.

name: anyforge_update_theme
title: Update theme
